description.value: Mountain Warehouse is a UK-based outdoor gear chain that designs and sells its own exclusive branded products, positioning itself as a lower-cost alternative to multi-brand outdoor retailers. The Kelowna location sits inside Orchard Park Shopping Centre, a large regional mall on Harvey Avenue. Touring cyclists may find general outdoor clothing, footwear, and camping accessories here, though it is not a dedicated cycling or bike service shop.
